name: Análisis de Fuerza de Colocación
description: Mide the strength and naturalness of word colocacións using mutual information scores para identificar generado por IA text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through abnormal word co-occurrence patrones and colocación preferences
mechanism: Extrae word pairs (bigrams, trigrams) and computes Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) and log-likelihood ratio scores para medir association strength. generado por IA text tends to favor high-frequency, 'safe' colocacións (e.g., 'significant impact', 'crucial role') while underusing creative, unusual, or idiomatic colocacións that are common in escritura humana. The method builds a colocación profile and compares it against reference corpora.
source: Church, K. W. & Hanks, P. (1990) - Word Association Norms, Mutual Information, and Lexicography, Computational Linguistics
algorithm: PMI Computation + Log-Likelihood Ratio + Collocation Profile Comparison
parameters: Window: 2-5 words, Metrics: PMI, t-score, log-likelihood, MI3, Min frequency: 2, Reference: BNC/COCA corpus
strengths:
• Captures subtle vocabulary combination patrones
• Well-established in corpus linguistics
• Detecta overuse of formulaic expressions
• Applicable a través de text types
limitations:
• Requires large reference corpora for reliable PMI
• Domain-specific colocacións confound análisis
• Multi-word expressions need special handling
• Language-specific colocación norms needed

references.title: Church, K. W. & Hanks, P. (1990). Word Association Norms, Mutual Information, and Lexicography. Computational Linguistics.
Evert, S. (2008). Corpora and Collocations. Corpus Linguistics: An International Handbook.
Clark, E. et al. (2021). All That's 'Human' Is Not Gold: Evaluating Human Evaluation of Generated Text. ACL.
